findings.message: The select param participanteId (effect select:formParticipante) has no request that fetches one record. Added public selectParticipante(id | null), which resolves the id against the loaded list, fills salvarMarcasDraft from the row and publishes client.selectionInvalid in listarParticipantesError when no row matches; the record is exposed by the getter formParticipante.
The param busca (filter:listaParticipantes, persisted) has no state in the definition. Added the persisted state busca, used by listarParticipantes(busca?, page, append).

The commands incluirParticipante and salvarMarcas have no <command>.input state. Added incluirParticipanteDraft and salvarMarcasDraft with setSetIncluirParticipanteDraft/setSalvarMarcasDraft setters (setIncluirParticipanteDraft, setSalvarMarcasDraft).

incluirParticipante returns the participant but no state has it as source: it is inserted by id in participantes and the user is removed from usuarios (no longer a candidate). pageStatus is not rewritten by commands, so it can stay 'empty' after including the first participant until the next load.
public busca is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
